items.title: Here Are Friday’s Top Wall Street Analyst Research Calls: Atmos Energy, Celanese, Check Point Software, Chewy, Dell Technologies, Fortinet, Global Payments, HP, Shopify, and More
items.summary: Markets are bracing for Friday's CPI data after a brutal week of selling across stocks, bonds, and crypto, and Wall Street analysts are already reshuffling their ratings on names like Dell, Shopify, Novo Nordisk, and Fortinet before the dust settles.

items.title: Judge denies motion to dismiss containerboard price-fixing lawsuit
items.summary: The federal judge cited significant consolidation within the containerboard market and “nearly lockstep price increases.” Many of the industry’s largest companies now move ahead to discovery.

items.title: Timber Was Gold in the South—Until a Market Collapse Crushed the Forest Economy
items.summary: The region has borne the brunt of a historic run of pulp and paper-mill closures. It’s the biggest threat to the rural economy since the fall of King Cotton.

items.title: Used box businesses eye opportunity amid rising containerboard prices
items.summary: Growth has been a slow burn for two leading used box resellers, but rising corrugated prices could provide a push. Some corrugated experts still question whether this will move the needle.
